articles.title: Uncontrolled killer robots? Nations struggle to set limits
articles.description: Is humanity facing a world of so-called "killer robots" that can track down enemy targets and people and kill them without human control? The danger is very real, weapons experts warn. Work is underway in many places on such lethal autonomous weapon systems (LAWS). In Geneva this week, 128 countries are striving to ensure that this horror scenario does not become a reality. It remains to be seen whether they can agree to adopt legal safeguards to restrict the development and use of such weapon systems.
